title: Transmission spool valve (multi-agent)
description: a transmission spool valve part used in an automatic transmission
reference_excerpt: The product in question is identified as a transmission spool valve, specifically item number 4631223000. It is a component of an automatic transmission's main control assembly. The spool valve is made from aluminum and is precisely machined to accommodate various valve components, including a ball check, a poppet, and spool mechanisms. These components work together to control the flow of hydraulic fluid within the transmission assembly. The ruling clarifies that the item is not a complete valve but rather a part of a valve mechanism used to form a spool valve within the transmission assembly.

text: {"heading":"8708","best_code":"8708.99.81.80","argument":"A transmission spool valve part is a component of an automatic transmission hydraulic control system used in motor vehicles. Heading 8708 covers 'Parts and accessories of the motor vehicles of headings 8701 to 8705.' The spool valve is a specialized part designed solely for use in automatic transmissions to control fluid flow and pressure. It falls under 8708.40 (Gear boxes and parts thereof) as a transmission control component, or more broadly under 8708.99 (Other parts and accessories). Within 8708.99, the part qualifies as 'Other parts for power trains' under 8708.99.68 or as 'Other' under 8708.99.81. Since a spool valve is a precision-machined metal component that does not fit the specific categories listed (brake hoses, wheel hub units, slide-in campers, cable traction devices), it falls under 8708.99.81.80 (Other). Section XVII note 2 does not exclude this part as a 'part of general use'—it is a specialized transmission control component. Chapter 87 note 1 does not apply (not railway stock). The part is solely or principally used as a component of automatic transmissions for motor vehicles, satisfying the requirement for parts classification under Section XVII.","supporting_rulings":[{"id":"963031","status":"in_force"},{"id":"N348390","status":"in_force"}],"exclusions_against":["Section XVII note 2(b) excludes 'parts of general use' of base metal, but a transmission spool valve is a specialized component, not a part of general use"],"strength":0.75}

memo.argument: A transmission spool valve part is a component of an automatic transmission hydraulic control system used in motor vehicles. Heading 8708 covers 'Parts and accessories of the motor vehicles of headings 8701 to 8705.' The spool valve is a specialized part designed solely for use in automatic transmissions to control fluid flow and pressure. It falls under 8708.40 (Gear boxes and parts thereof) as a transmission control component, or more broadly under 8708.99 (Other parts and accessories). Within 8708.99, the part qualifies as 'Other parts for power trains' under 8708.99.68 or as 'Other' under 8708.99.81. Since a spool valve is a precision-machined metal component that does not fit the specific categories listed (brake hoses, wheel hub units, slide-in campers, cable traction devices), it falls under 8708.99.81.80 (Other). Section XVII note 2 does not exclude this part as a 'part of general use'—it is a specialized transmission control component. Chapter 87 note 1 does not apply (not railway stock). The part is solely or principally used as a component of automatic transmissions for motor vehicles, satisfying the requirement for parts classification under Section XVII.
exclusions_against: Section XVII note 2(b) excludes 'parts of general use' of base metal, but a transmission spool valve is a specialized component, not a part of general use

text: {"heading":"8481","best_code":"8481.90.90.85","argument":"Heading 8481 covers 'Taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances, for pipes, boiler shells, tanks, vats or the like, including pressure-reducing valves and thermostatically controlled valves; parts thereof.' The part falls squarely within the scope of heading 8481 as a part of a valve appliance. Subheading 8481.90 provides for 'Parts' of such valves. The 10-digit code 8481.90.90.85 classifies other parts not specifically enumerated, which is appropriate for a spool valve component. text: {"heading":"8483","best_code":"8483.90.80.00","argument":"A transmission spool valve part is a component of an automatic transmission control system. Heading 8483 covers 'Transmission shafts (including camshafts and crankshafts) and cranks; bearing housings, housed bearings and plain shaft bearings; gears and gearing; ball or roller screws; gear boxes and other speed changers, including torque converters; flywheels and pulleys, including pulley blocks; clutches and shaft couplings (including universal joints); parts thereof.' The spool valve is a part of transmission control mechanisms and falls within the scope of 'parts thereof' under heading 8483. Subheading 8483.90 covers 'Toothed wheels, chain sprockets and other transmission elements presented separately; parts.' The spool valve, as a metal part of a transmission control assembly, classifies as 'Other' parts under 8483.90.80.00. Section XVI note 2(b) provides that parts suitable for use solely or principally with a particular kind of machine are classified with that machine or in the appropriate parts heading. A transmission spool valve is suitable for use solely with automatic transmissions, supporting classification in heading 8483 as a transmission part.","supporting_rulings":[{"id":"N348390","status":"in_force"},{"id":"N268111","status":"in_force"}],"exclusions_against":["Section XVI note 1(g) excludes 'Parts of general use, as defined in note 2 to section XV, of base metal' but a transmission spool valve is not a part of general use—it is specifically designed for transmission control.","The rulings found (N348390, N268111) classify similar valve body assemblies and valve bodies under heading 8481 (Valves), not 8483, which suggests valve components may be more appropriately classified as valves rather than transmission parts."],"strength":0.45}

memo.argument: A transmission spool valve part is a component of an automatic transmission control system. Heading 8483 covers 'Transmission shafts (including camshafts and crankshafts) and cranks; bearing housings, housed bearings and plain shaft bearings; gears and gearing; ball or roller screws; gear boxes and other speed changers, including torque converters; flywheels and pulleys, including pulley blocks; clutches and shaft couplings (including universal joints); parts thereof.' The spool valve is a part of transmission control mechanisms and falls within the scope of 'parts thereof' under heading 8483. Subheading 8483.90 covers 'Toothed wheels, chain sprockets and other transmission elements presented separately; parts.' The spool valve, as a metal part of a transmission control assembly, classifies as 'Other' parts under 8483.90.80.00. Section XVI note 2(b) provides that parts suitable for use solely or principally with a particular kind of machine are classified with that machine or in the appropriate parts heading. A transmission spool valve is suitable for use solely with automatic transmissions, supporting classification in heading 8483 as a transmission part.
exclusions_against: Section XVI note 1(g) excludes 'Parts of general use, as defined in note 2 to section XV, of base metal' but a transmission spool valve is not a part of general use—it is specifically designed for transmission control.

The rulings found (N348390, N268111) classify similar valve body assemblies and valve bodies under heading 8481 (Valves), not 8483, which suggests valve components may be more appropriately classified as valves rather than transmission parts.
